name: kfp-notebook
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "kfp-notebook" %}
{% set version = "4.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 82fe2a2f1649238554ad004371ecc0e7c1f7b895debe82bd2827a393d5b7cd5b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - kfp >=1.6.3
    # elyra/kfp/bootstrapper.py imports packaging at module level, but
    # upstream does not declare it as a dependency
    - packaging

test:
  imports:
    - elyra.kfp.bootstrapper
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/elyra-ai/elyra
  dev_url: https://github.com/elyra-ai/elyra
  doc_url: https://elyra.readthedocs.io/en/latest
  license: Apache-2.0
  # The sdist ships no license file; recipe/LICENSE is elyra-ai/elyra's LICENSE
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Elyra bootstrapper that runs notebooks and Python or R scripts as Kubeflow Pipelines tasks
  description: >
    kfp-notebook provides elyra.kfp.bootstrapper, which Elyra uses to run
    generic pipeline nodes (Jupyter notebooks and Python or R scripts) as
    Kubeflow Pipelines tasks. Since 3.0.1 it is published from elyra-ai/elyra;
    earlier releases came from the archived elyra-ai/kfp-notebook project.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akchinSTC
    - lresende
